# Assets · Logos

1 file under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for lwtv-toaster.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

`lwtv-toaster.svg` is the LezWatch.TV rainbow toaster, copied unchanged from `images/lwtv-toaster.svg` in the theme. It is multi-color, so use it as an `<img>` on `surface` in light or dark and leave its colors alone. Check it on the dark surface: its black parts may need a light backing plate there.
